description: Voting is one of our most fundamental rights and the best way that the average American can make his or her voice heard, we must make voting as easy and as efficient as possible for all eligible citizens. No one should be denied a vote simply because lack of resources, lack of time, age, belonging to “the wrong party,” or skin color prevents them from carrying out this sacred duty as a citizen.
